title: packet_bandwidth missing-key loader default is the stale pre-tuning 30 and passes validation — a dropped key silently reverts the 4x pace
detail: Every sibling knob either defaults to the shipped value (max_ticks 100000, snap_radius 36) or defaults to a value failing validation (logic_hz 0, lane_queue_packets 0, new knobs -1). packet_bandwidth's default 30 now diverges from shipped 120 yet validates — the designated fun-test knob can silently revert pace.
recommended_fix: Default packet_bandwidth to 0 so the existing <=0 check fails fast on a missing key (matching logic_hz/lane_queue_packets), or to 120 to restore default==shipped.

title: demos/growth.dem header still documents the deleted GROWTH_INTERVAL_TICKS const and the old 40-tick/2 s cadence

# aggregation event — the surge needs the grown crowd of content_hosts)
# (GROWTH_INTERVAL_TICKS = 120 @ 20 Hz), deterministically from the seed +

recommended_fix: Update the growth.dem header to name terminal_spawn_interval_ticks (balance.json) and the 80-tick/4 s windows; fix the tick list at line 25.

title: Demo headers keep bandwidth-30 transit arithmetic after the 30→120 retune; the per-tick walkthroughs now misdescribe the re-blessed streams
evidence:
# Transit (bandwidth 30 vs standard cap 15 -> 2 ticks/edge): each packet takes
# res->mid (2 ticks), mid->host (2 ticks), +2 forwarding ticks = 6 ticks, e.g.
detail: Also ecmp_cost.dem:26 ("packet_bandwidth 30 -> wide (cap 40) = 1 tick/edge, standard (15) = 2 ticks/edge") and audio_throttle.dem:4 ("ceil(30/28) = 2 ticks per edge"). Goldens were re-blessed at 120; the docs mislead future golden-diff debugging.
recommended_fix: Sweep the demo headers' transit math to the 120-based values (standard = 8 ticks/edge) or phrase it catalog-derived (ceil(packet_bandwidth/cap)).

title: Migrated terminal_spawn_interval_ticks lacks the zero-guard both sibling knobs carry — an in-code Balance literal omitting it hits modulo-by-zero
detail: Contrast topology.odin:343 "if sep < 1 { sep = 1 }" ("even for an in-code Balance{} literal that omits placement") and growth.odin's own "if sep < 1 { sep2 = 1 }" for min_sep. wire_path_test.odin:56 already omits the knobs. determinism_test.odin:55's "a zeroed interval would spawn every tick" is wrong — it panics.
recommended_fix: Clamp at the schedule check (iv := max(1, cat.balance.terminal_spawn_interval_ticks) — the placement-guard pattern) and correct the determinism_test comment.
